errors.text_span: The slices are colored as follows: "Business" is dark blue (5.9%), "Geography" is light green (2.7%), "Math" is dark gray (1.2%), "Game&Anime" is orange (8.2%), "Science" is teal (6.7%), "Econ. & Fin." is cyan (18.4%), "Law" is light blue (5.1%), "History" is purple (8.2%), "Med & Health" is yellow (6.7%), "Pet & Animal" is light brown (5.5%), "AI/NLP Research" is a lighter shade of blue (24.3%), and "Daily Life" is pink (7.1%).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps nearly all categories to their corresponding colors. For example, it states that 'Business' is dark blue when it is actually red, 'Geography' is light green when it is yellow, 'Math' is dark gray when it is green, 'Science' is teal when it is light blue, and so on. The color mappings are almost entirely incorrect.

errors.text_span: Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice.
errors.evidence: The percentage labels are not located inside the slices. They are positioned outside the pie chart with leader lines pointing to their respective slices.

errors.text_span: The segments appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest
errors.evidence: The slices of the pie chart are not ordered by size. For example, the largest slice, 'AI/NLP Research' (24.3%), is adjacent to a much smaller slice, 'Business' (5.9%). Similarly, the second largest slice, 'Econ. & Fin.' (18.4%), is next to 'Science' (6.7%).
